title: Unit 4: Family Ties: Comparatives & Family Relationships
objective: Mampu meminta izin dengan sopan, berbicara tentang keluarga menggunakan kata ganti kepemilikan (possessive adjectives and pronouns), serta menggunakan 'whose' dan bentuk lampau 'was/were' dengan tepat

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menyatakan kepemilikan dalam bahasa Inggris, baik dengan kata sifat kepemilikan (my, your, his, her) maupun kata ganti kepemilikan (mine, yours, his, hers). Kamu juga akan belajar kapan menggunakan 'whose' untuk bertanya tentang kepemilikan, dan cara menggunakan 'was/were' untuk menceritakan keadaan di masa lampau.
rules: Possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their) diletakkan SEBELUM kata benda. Contoh: It's my book. / That's your bike.
Possessive pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs) MENGGANTIKAN kata benda, tidak perlu kata benda lagi. Contoh: The book is mine. / That bike is yours.
Untuk bertanya kepemilikan, gunakan 'Whose + kata benda'. Contoh: Whose phone is this? / Whose bike is that?
Untuk menyatakan kepemilikan pada nama, tambahkan 's (apostrof + s). Contoh: Kate's bike / Rashid's dog. Jika nama berakhir dengan 's', cukup tambahkan apostrof: James' book.
Was/were digunakan untuk menceritakan keadaan lampau. Was untuk I/he/she/it, were untuk you/we/they. Contoh: It was a lovely day. / The girls were worried.
Bentuk negatif: wasn't (was not) dan weren't (were not). Contoh: There wasn't a cloud in the sky. / They weren't scared.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampuradukkan Possessive Adjective dan Pronoun
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering salah menggunakan possessive adjective dan pronoun. Ingat: possessive adjective harus diikuti kata benda, sedangkan possessive pronoun berdiri sendiri tanpa kata benda.
commonTrap.wrong: That sandwich is my. / The book is your.
commonTrap.correct: That sandwich is mine. / The book is yours.

dialogue.context: Lucy dan Kathy (kakaknya) sedang berbicara tentang meminjam pakaian

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Can I borrow your yellow and black shirt?
lines.translation: Bolehkah aku meminjam baju kuning dan hitammu?

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: No, you can't. (asking her sister, not parents)
lines.translation: Tidak, tidak boleh. (bertanya pada kakaknya, bukan orang tua)

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul ingin mengenal keluargamu dan melatih kemampuan meminta izin dalam bahasa Inggris

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's talk about families today. Tell me, who is your favourite family member and why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My favourite family member is my uncle because he's really funny.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! What's your uncle's name? And does he live near you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: His name is Ahmad. He lives in Jakarta, quite far from my house.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. Now, imagine you want to borrow your brother's or sister's bicycle. How would you ask for permission?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! And if they say yes, what would you say to thank them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you so much! I'll be careful with it.

quiz.question: Choose the correct word: 'Whose / Who's son is Bart?'
quiz.explanation: 'Whose' digunakan untuk bertanya tentang kepemilikan (milik siapa). 'Who's' adalah singkatan dari 'who is'. Jadi yang benar adalah 'Whose son is Bart?' (Bart adalah anak siapa?)

quiz.question: Complete: 'The book is ___.' (talking about my book)
quiz.explanation: Karena tidak ada kata benda setelahnya, gunakan possessive pronoun 'mine'. Jika ada kata benda, baru gunakan 'my' (my book).

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: It was a lovely day. There wasn't a cloud in the sky.
It were a lovely day. There wasn't a cloud in the sky.
It was a lovely day. There weren't a cloud in the sky.
quiz.answer: It was a lovely day. There wasn't a cloud in the sky.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'was' untuk subjek tunggal (it, a cloud). 'Were' hanya untuk subjek jamak atau 'you'.

quiz.question: How do you ask for permission to go out?
quiz.explanation: Untuk meminta izin, gunakan 'Can I...' di awal kalimat sebagai pertanyaan.

quiz.question: Complete: 'I'm sure that's Kate's / Kates' bike.'
quiz.explanation: Untuk menunjukkan kepemilikan pada nama tunggal, tambahkan apostrof + s ('s). 'Kate's bike' berarti sepeda milik Kate.

quiz.question: Which word describes this feeling: happy because a problem is finished?
quiz.explanation: 'Relieved' berarti merasa lega setelah masalah selesai atau ketegangan hilang.
